Apple devices are already on sale for Black Friday. This includes Apple's newest generation MacBook Air 15-inch Laptop, which has just dropped to its lowest price since the official price hike back in June of 2026. Amazon is slashing $250 off the base model, which includes an M5 chip, 16GB of RAM, and a 512GB SSD, now just $1,2450 with free shipping.

Save $250 Off the 2026 Apple Macbook Air 15" M5 (16GB/512GB)

The MacBook Air 15" M5 was released on March 11, 2026. It features a 15.3" 2880x1864 (224ppi) Retina display with P3 Wide Color and True Tone, Apple M5 chip with 10-core CPU, 10-core GPU, and 16-core NPU (for AI), 16GB of unified RAM, and a 512GB SSD. The MacBook Air measures 0.45" thin and weighs 3.3 pounds, thanks to its unibody aluminum chassis. Connectivity options include two Thunderbolt 4 (USB Type-C) ports for high-speed storage expansion or peripherals. The MacBook Air is also equipped with Apple's new N1 networking chip with Wi-Fi 7 support.

Because the MacBook Air offers so much versatility for its price, it's the best MacBook to buy for most people. Currently this laptop with identical specs still costs $1,499 from the Apple Store. Buying it from Amazon will get you the same 1 year Apple warranty, since Amazon is an authorized Apple reseller, and you can still extend it with AppleCare.
